verdicts.reason: Both break the original's three equal stacked ribbons. NEW YORK is a big band, while SUBWAY and GUIDE are small stubs with a different text indent, so the title no longer reads as one block. In both, the beige diagonal shapes are broken into arbitrary floating fragments, the photo is cropped so the sign reads 'BWAY', and the bottom third is dead space. A spaces the ribbons further apart, which scatters the title. B keeps them tight and near the top, closer to the original, but its fragments sit on the sign's 'B' with a stray ghost shape, so the two are almost equivalent.
